cross_component_finding: This page states doc_config.mode can be toggled to "scope.collection.type_field" or "scope.collection.docid_prefix" - values with a 'scope.collection.' prefix that do NOT appear among the promoted search:doc-config-mode-enum's four canonical values (type_field | docid_prefix | docid_regexp | custom, per the registry digest). This isn't necessarily a contradiction - the prefixed forms read as collection-aware VARIANTS of the same two base modes, layered on top of the plain enum by this FLEX feature - but it's a real extension the promoted enum's own description doesn't capture. Recorded here rather than silently merged into the plain enum values; the reconciliation pass should decide whether search:doc-config-mode-enum's value set needs a note about these collection-scoped variants or whether they're better modeled as a distinct FLEX-specific enum.
